snippet.title: Sheep -  Video Game Trailer (PC Windows/PS1/Macintosh, 2000)
snippet.description:
Sheep - Video game trailer.
Developed by Minds Eye Productions

Published in November 2000 by Empire Interactive Entertainment for PS1 and PC Windows.
A Macintosh version was published in 2001 by Feral Interactive (port by Similis Software)

Video found on coverdisc CD from French Magazine "PsOne Mag" (Issue #01, December 2000)
